correctness.rationale: The exact half-flux band condition of arXiv:2302.04601 is expanded with k=N_n+x/N_n. The leading function 6-8/x^2 has simple roots at x=±1 and x=±sqrt(2) for the edge equations R=±2. The implicit-function expansion and exact conversion k^2-N_n^2=2x+x^2/N_n^2 give all four coefficients. The packaged standard-library verifier numerically solves the exact edge equations and checks the N_n^-4 remainder behavior. The claim is limited to the fixed local window and does not infer infinite behavior from finite experiments.
